constitution.title: Конституция Кыргызской Республики (принята референдумом 11 апреля 2021 года)
constitution.publisher: Центральная комиссия по выборам и проведению референдумов Кыргызской Республики (ЦИК КР)
constitution.note: Text as the CEC hosts it. Art. 2(3-5): elections and referendums; art. 7: the People's Kurultai, a consultative assembly; art. 67(1): the President is elected for 5 years; art. 70: who may call a referendum; art. 76(2): the Jogorku Kenesh has 90 deputies elected for 5 years; art. 95: judges are appointed; art. 113(1): local kenesh deputies are elected by the residents of their administrative-territorial unit.

Art. 48: regular presidential elections on the fourth Wednesday of January of the year the term ends; arts. 55-56: a majority of those voting in the first round, else a runoff of the top two; art. 59: 90 deputies for 5 years in 30 three-member districts by the majoritarian system, a vacated seat passes to the next candidate of the same sex, polling on a Wednesday of the month the term ends; art. 63: repeat elections; art. 64: the three candidates with the most votes win. classes.name: Кыргыз Республикасынын Президентин шайлоо
classes.finest_note: CEC open data by oblast and territorial commission (rayon or city) from 2011; protocols of lower commissions are published under art. 39(3) of the 2011 constitutional law
classes.note: Direct election for 5 years (Constitution art. 67): a candidate needs over half of those who voted, else a runoff of the top two decided by plurality (constitutional law arts. 55-56). Regular elections fall on the fourth Wednesday of January of the year the term ends (art. 48), 27 January 2027 next; early elections are called by the Jogorku Kenesh within a week of a vacancy and held within 3 months. The 1991, 1995, 2000, 2005, and 2009 elections are not on the CEC's site; the President elected on 10 January 2021 under the 2010 Constitution serves to January 2027.

cadence.locator: https://shailoo.gov.kg/ru/konstitucionnye-zakony-kr/konstitucionnye-zakony-kr/O_vyborah_Pr-1913/ (art. 48(1): "в четвертую среду января года, в котором истекает срок полномочий Президента"; Constitution art. 67(1): 5 years)
cadence.runoff_rule: Over half of those who voted wins in the first round; otherwise the top two meet within 20 days and the plurality wins (arts. 55-56).
cadence.administered_by: Central Commission for Elections and Referendums (CEC)
cadence.vacancy_rule: Early election called by the Jogorku Kenesh within a week of the vacancy and held within three months (art. 48(2)).

access.evidence: Tables by oblast and territorial commission for 2011, 2017, and 2021, with xlsx downloads

dates.note: Elections of 1991, 1995, 2000, 2005 (early), and 2009 are not published on the CEC's site; their counts await the CEC's printed reports.

classes.name: Жогорку Кеңештин депутаттарын шайлоо
classes.finest_note: 2010-2021 by oblast and territorial commission in CEC open data; 2021 single-member districts and the 2025 multi-member districts by district
classes.note: Systems: 120 seats by national party lists in one district (2010, 2015, and the annulled 2020 election); 54 list seats and 36 single-member seats (2021); since 2025, 90 deputies in 30 three-member districts, each voter marking one candidate and the top three winning, with a sex rule on vacancies (constitutional law arts. 59 and 64). Term 5 years (Constitution art. 76(2)); regular elections on a Wednesday of the month the term ends; early elections when the Kenesh dissolves itself. Bicameral from 1995 to 2005 (Legislative Assembly and Assembly of People's Representatives), unicameral from 2005; the 1995, 2000, 2005, and 2007 elections are not on the CEC's site.

cadence.locator: https://shailoo.gov.kg/ru/konstitucionnye-zakony-kr/konstitucionnye-zakony-kr/O_vyborah_Pr-1913/ (art. 59(1): "сроком на 5 лет"; 59(5): "Днем голосования является среда месяца, в котором истекает конституционный срок"; 59(6): early elections)
cadence.administered_by: Central Commission for Elections and Referendums (CEC)
cadence.vacancy_rule: The mandate passes to the next candidate of the same sex in the district; a by-election is held only when no such candidate remains (art. 59(9)-(10)).

classes.note: Party-list proportional representation across the whole city (Law No. 98 art. 47), for five years (Law No. 3 of 2000 art. 2). Until 2024 councils were elected on staggered days (2016-2023 pages list regular, early, and repeat elections of some councils several times a year); a presidential decree dissolved every local kenesh and all were elected on 17 November 2024.

cadence.locator: https://shailoo.gov.kg/ru/ZakonodatelstvoMyyzamdar/ZakonyMyyzamdar/o-statuse-deputatov-mestnyh-keneshej/ (art. 2: "сроком на пять лет"); Law No. 98 art. 48: called by the President at least 60 days ahead
cadence.administered_by: Central Commission for Elections and Referendums (CEC) through the territorial election commissions
cadence.vacancy_rule: The mandate passes to the next candidate of the same sex on the party's list (Law No. 98 art. 52(1-1)).

access.platform: CEC protocols of the local kenesh elections of 17 November 2024
access.evidence: One PDF per council: electors, ballots, each party's votes and mandates, and the elected
Results of the city kenesh elections of March 2016 and April 2021, one page per council

dates.note: Councils were elected on staggered days; the CEC's pages from May 2016 list regular, early, and repeat elections of some councils, not yet counted.

dates.quote: На заседании Центральной избирательной комиссии утверждены протоколы об итогах голосования и о результатах выборов, 33 городских и 231 айылных кенешей

classes.name: Айылдык кеңештердин депутаттарын шайлоо
classes.finest_note: Votes per candidate in each multi-member district of the council in the CEC's PDF protocols (2024)
classes.note: Majoritarian voting in multi-member districts drawn by the territorial commission, with at least 30 percent of each council's mandates reserved for women (Law No. 98 arts. 47, 59, and 59-1), for five years. Staggered until 2024; all ayil keneshes were elected on 17 November 2024 after the territorial reform cut them from 453 to 231.

cadence.locator: https://shailoo.gov.kg/ru/ZakonodatelstvoMyyzamdar/ZakonyMyyzamdar/o-statuse-deputatov-mestnyh-keneshej/ (art. 2: "сроком на пять лет"); Law No. 98 art. 48
cadence.administered_by: Central Commission for Elections and Referendums (CEC) through the territorial election commissions
cadence.vacancy_rule: The mandate passes to the next candidate with the most votes in the same district (Law No. 98 art. 52(1)1).

access.platform: CEC protocols of the local kenesh elections of 17 November 2024
access.evidence: One PDF per council with columns per multi-member district (the Ат-Башы council has 8)

dates.note: Councils were elected on staggered days; the CEC's pages from May 2016 list regular, early, and repeat elections of some councils, not yet counted. The CEC's open data gives 453 ayil and 31 city keneshes with 8,722 mandates before the reform.

dates.quote: утверждены протоколы об итогах голосования и о результатах выборов, 33 городских и 231 айылных кенешей

classes.name: Жергиликтүү өз алдынча башкаруу органдарынын башчылары
classes.name_en: Heads of local executive bodies (ayil okmotu heads and mayors)
classes.note: Executive bodies of local self-government answer to the representative bodies (Constitution art. 112(2)); the CEC lists the heads and kenesh chairs in office and the early selections of heads 2016-2020.
classes.disposition_reason: Heads are chosen by the local kenesh or appointed, not by a vote of residents; the CEC lists who holds the post, with no popular vote to load.

classes.name: Элдик Курултай
classes.note: A public-representative assembly that gives recommendations on social development (Constitution art. 7), organized under a constitutional law.
classes.disposition_reason: A consultative assembly whose delegates are not chosen in elections run by the CEC under the electoral laws.

classes.name: Судьялар
classes.note: Judges of local courts are appointed by the President on the proposal of the Council for Justice Affairs; chairs of the Constitutional and Supreme Courts are appointed with the Jogorku Kenesh's consent (Constitution art. 95).
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed, never elected by voters.
